description: Read Dayforce employees, time entries, schedules, time off, balances, pay and reports, add time entries, time off and pay adjustments, and start workflows when someone is hired, leaves, clocks in or asks for time off.

dayforce_employee_terminated_trigger.description: Runs each time an employee's termination is entered in Dayforce (up to 90 days ahead of the termination date). Ones entered before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.employee: The employee's XRef code, for 'Get employee'.
output.record: The employee as Dayforce's list gives it.

parameters.description: Only in this org unit (location), by XRef code. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: org_unit

dayforce_new_clock_swipe_trigger.description: Runs for each new clock swipe in Dayforce. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 2,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.punch_type: The kind of swipe, such as Punch_In.
output.record: The whole swipe as Dayforce gives it.

parameters.description: Only this employee, by XRef code. Leave empty for everyone.
parameters.name: employee

dayforce_new_hire_trigger.description: Runs for each employee hired in Dayforce, as soon as the hire is entered (up to 90 days ahead of the hire date). Hires entered before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.employee: The employee's XRef code, for 'Get employee'.
output.record: The employee as Dayforce's list gives it.

parameters.description: Only in this org unit (location), by XRef code. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: org_unit

dayforce_new_job_posting_trigger.description: Runs for each new job posting in Dayforce. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 2,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.job_details_url: The address of the posting's page.
output.record: The whole posting as Dayforce gives it.
output.title: The job title.

dayforce_new_shift_trigger.description: Runs for each shift scheduled in Dayforce for the next 28 days. Shifts already scheduled when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.published: True once the schedule is published to the employee.
output.record: The whole shift as Dayforce gives it.
output.time_start: When the shift starts, local time.

parameters.description: Only this employee, by XRef code. Leave empty for everyone.
parameters.name: employee

parameters.description: Only in this org unit (location), by XRef code. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: org_unit

dayforce_new_time_off_request_trigger.description: Runs for each pending time-off request one employee makes in Dayforce. Requests already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: The whole request as Dayforce gives it.
output.time_off_code: The request's XRef code, for 'Update time off'.

parameters.description: The employee to watch, by XRef code.
parameters.name: employee

output.changed_at: When it was added or changed, in UTC.
output.pay_adjustment_code: The pay adjustment code, such as BONUS.
output.record: The whole pay adjustment as Dayforce gives it.
